_comments.overview: Optimized MCP config - Essential 5 only, no bloat
_comments.why_this_config: Lean, focused, high-value tools for Claude Code
_comments.claude_code_note: Claude Code has excellent built-in file/terminal access - no need for desktop-commander

essential_5.firecrawl: 🔥 CRITICAL - Web scraping & content extraction (requires API key)
essential_5.github: 🐙 CRITICAL - Git automation & PR creation (requires token)
essential_5.context7: 📚 HIGH VALUE - Current API docs, prevents hallucination
essential_5.brave-search: 🔍 HIGH VALUE - Real-time web search (requires API key)

optional_add_later.puppeteer: Browser automation for E2E testing - npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer
optional_add_later.desktop-commander: File system access (NOT needed in Claude Code, redundant bloat)

api_keys_required: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY - Get free tier at https://firecrawl.dev (500 credits/mo)
BRAVE_API_KEY - Get free tier at https://brave.com/search/api (2,000 queries/mo)
